verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API jobs that chain import, convert and export tasks, but each job is a one-off action submitted programmatically. CloudConvert itself documents no schedule, trigger or recurring automation. Ongoing automated workflows come only through Zapier, a third-party platform. These are developer building blocks and an external-platform workaround, not a first-party background-automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
